import itertools
import random
random.seed(42)
weeks = 6
players = 36
groups_per_week = 9
group_size = 4
all_groups = list(itertools.combinations(range(players), group_size))
random.shuffle(all_groups)
# Now build the schedule greedily
schedule = []
used_pairs = set()
for w in range(weeks):
    week_groups = []
    used_this_week = set()
    for g in all_groups:
        if len(week_groups) == groups_per_week:
            break
        ps = set(g)
        if ps & used_this_week:
            continue
        # Check pairs
        pairs = list(itertools.combinations(g, 2))
        if any(p in used_pairs for p in pairs):
            continue
        # Accept
        week_groups.append(g)
        used_this_week.update(ps)
        for p in pairs:
            used_pairs.add(p)
    if len(week_groups) < groups_per_week:
        print("Failed at week", w, "got", len(week_groups))
        break
    schedule.append(week_groups)
    print("Week", w, "success")
else:
    print("Success")
    # Now create the flat list
    golfer_to_group = [[0]*players for _ in range(weeks)]
    for w in range(weeks):
        for g_idx, grp in enumerate(schedule[w]):
            for p in grp:
                golfer_to_group[w][p] = g_idx
    flat = [golfer_to_group[w][p] for w in range(weeks) for p in range(players)]
    print(flat)
